title: Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to start and stop EC2 instances Monday to Friday
description: Pattern that starts and stops given EC2 instances based on time of day, timezone and days of week

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Creates a schedule that turns on instances at 08:00 and turns them off at 17:00 Monday to Friday using the US/Eastern timezone.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.

authors.name: Ian Lodge
authors.bio: Ian is a Solutions Architect at Amazon Web Services based in the US.
